name: kenya-health-mcp
description: MCP server for Kenya health data: SHIF contributions (NHIF's successor), a small facility sample, maternal health, health rights EN/SW

tools.name: get_shif_contribution
tools.description: Calculate the monthly Social Health Insurance Fund (SHIF) contribution for a gross monthly salary in KES. Use when someone asks what SHIF takes from their pay. SHIF replaced NHIF in October 2024: 2.75% of gross pay, minimum KES 300, no cap, paid by the employee only. Returns gross_salary_kes, employee_contribution_kes, employer_match_kes (0), total_monthly_kes, the rate, the source (Social Health Insurance Act 2023; sha.go.ke premium rates, checked 2026-10-05) and a note to verify current rates. Read-only.

tools.name: get_nhif_contribution
tools.description: DEPRECATED NAME kept for compatibility: NHIF no longer exists. Use when a client still refers to NHIF; it returns exactly what get_shif_contribution returns plus a deprecated field, so prefer get_shif_contribution. Returns the SHIF contribution for the gross monthly salary in KES (2.75% of gross, minimum KES 300, no cap, employee only) with the source and a note to verify rates at sha.go.ke. Read-only.

tools.name: find_facility
tools.description: Find sample public health facilities in a Kenyan county, optionally by KEPH level. Use when someone asks where to go for care. level: 4 district, 5 regional referral, 6 national referral, 0 for all. A small hand-compiled sample, NOT the Kenya Master Health Facility List (kmhfl.health.go.ke): it is incomplete, so an unknown county returns an empty list with a note, never a guess. Returns the county, the facilities, a note, the emergency numbers (999 or 112; Kenya Red Cross 1199) and the source label. Read-only.

tools.name: get_maternal_protocol
tools.description: Kenya's antenatal care schedule and how maternity care is covered now that SHA has replaced NHIF: antenatal visits, postnatal care, newborn vaccines and birth registration. Use when someone asks what care to expect in pregnancy and after birth. Takes no arguments. Returns the visit schedule, coverage notes (reported, not verified here), vaccine timing, birth registration guidance and the source (Ministry of Health Kenya). General information, not medical advice. Read-only.

tools.name: get_health_right
tools.description: Kenya's constitutional health rights under Article 43 of the Constitution of Kenya 2010, by topic: healthcare, maternal or emergency. Use when someone asks what they are entitled to. An unknown topic returns an error listing the available topics. Returns the right, its legal basis and related articles. Not legal advice: check the Constitution on kenyalaw.org. Read-only.
